topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations, beamforming strategies must adapt to the rapidly fluctuating angles of arrival caused by the high velocity of aircraft. Phased array antennas can be used for adaptive beamforming, exploiting the aircraft's GPS for synchronization and navigation purposes. Machine Learning (ML) based adaptive beamforming can optimize beamforming performance in real-time, taking into account the changing environment of A2A links. Spatial spacing optimization is crucial to minimize interference and maximize LOS connectivity. Channel State Information (CSI) sharing between aircraft can be used to facilitate adaptive beamforming and optimize beamforming performance in real-time.
reference_context: A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations experience rapidly fluctuating frequency selective fading due to high aircraft velocity, requiring adaptive beamforming to track changing angles of arrival and mitigate Rician distributed fading and frequency selective fading. Aircraft GPS provides a global time reference for synchronization among network nodes, facilitating contention-free transmissions.
